entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi, Isaac. I... I need to return something. I'm just so disappointed. I ordered a helmet a while back and it's just been sitting here.
I'm sorry to hear you're disappointed. I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have the order number handy?
Yes, it's VF88675. I've been a loyal customer for so long, and I was really looking forward to it, but... it's just not right.
Okay, I have the order pulled up. I see the helmet was delivered about 73 days ago. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

It's just the color. It looked so different on the website. I was so excited, but when it arrived, my heart just sank. The box is still unopened, I haven't even touched it. I really needed that money back for other things.
I understand completely. It's important you're happy with your gear, especially when it comes to safety equipment like a helmet. Let me just quickly review our policy for you. One moment.
Okay... I hope you can help.

Alright, thank you for your patience. I've confirmed that since this is a standard item, it's covered by our 90-day return policy. You are well within that window, so I can absolutely approve this return for you for a full refund.
Oh, really? That's... that's wonderful news! Thank you so much, Isaac. That's a huge relief.

You're very welcome. Your satisfaction and safety are our top priorities. I'm sending the pre-paid return label to the email on file now. Just print it out, attach it to the package, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive the unopened box, your refund will be processed.
I will. Thank you again. You've been a great help.
My pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today for VeloFit?
No, that's everything. Have a good day.
You too. Thanks for calling VeloFit.
